reviews.body:
The stock-only absence normalization is sound and strictly loosens a previously fail-closed path in the safe direction: absent words map to '0*' on both the tool and the answer side, while unknown stock and nonnumeric usage still reject, and the two new tests reproduce the real 2abd71d capture (one 313-row handoff, 48 absent rows) rather than asserting anything trivially true. No blocking defect…


<details><summary>Impact and review coverage</summary>

- Impact: A full-detail BOM turn whose tool output spells absent stock differently from the five accepted literals still fails with tool-detail-incomplete even when the answer is a faithful transcription.
- Not covered: The 420-line JSON and 328-line Markdown live captures were verified for structure, question/answer identity, row and absent-marker counts and absence of credentials or host paths, not read line by li…

</details>

## Items to confirm (nonblocking)

- **packages/openbkn-business-context/src/answer-fidelity.ts** — The absent-stock vocabulary is a five-literal whitelist derived from one live run, but managed-session-policy.ts:82 only tells the model to reuse "absent-row markers" without fixing the token it must print. Consider pin…
- **packages/openbkn-business-context/src/answer-fidelity.ts** — renderDetail now emits '0*' / '?' for rows whose tool cells said 无合格库存行 / 未提供, and the rendered table carries no legend for '*'. The steering notice asks the model to copy that transcription, so the corrected answer can…

The follow-up commit 6dff220 resolves both prior nonblocking items: NO_ROW is now matched case-insensitively while the Chinese literals are unaffected by toLowerCase(), and renderDetail appends '*' / '?' legends that parseDetail skips (no '|'), so the correction table still round-trips to zero issues. No blocking defect found in this round.
